description: Alaska Marine Highway System ferry schedules from the State of Alaska's official schedule grids, by month and route or vessel (Cross Gulf, Prince William Sound, SE Mainlines, SE Communities, SW and Aleutian Chain, M/V Columbia, M/V Kennicott …): for each direction the ports in order and every sailing with vessel, sailing ID and, per port, local date and time and whether it is a departure or arrival (ports skipped are left out). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

month.description: YYYY-MM (published months only, usually the next ~6)
